title: Planning puts kb/_self/code.md in the touches of an item that adds an import between _tools modules
goal: kb/_self/code.md lists each bl_ module's imports, so the ST-cdkj7nza worker (SP-mujl7ebh) stopped when its bl_dispatch import of bl_plan needed a code.md line outside its touches, and the orchestrator widened them and resumed it; check warns of a code item whose goal or notes name a new import between _tools modules whose import list code.md documents, when code.md is not in its touches.

run:
import sys, os, json, tempfile, types, io, contextlib, subprocess
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bl_base, bl_check
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
subprocess.run(['git', 'init', '-q', d], check=True)
os.makedirs(os.path.join(d, '_tools'))
os.makedirs(os.path.join(d, 'kb', '_self', 'backlog'))
for n in ('_tools/bl_plan.py', '_tools/bl_dispatch.py', '_tools/bl_cost.py', 'kb/_self/code.md'):
    open(os.path.join(d, n), 'w').write('x = 1' + chr(10))
subprocess.run(['git', '-C', d, 'add', '.'], check=True)
def put(it):
    open(os.path.join(d, 'kb', '_self', 'backlog', it['id'] + '.json'), 'w').write(json.dumps(it))
bad = [dict(run=['python3', '-c', 'import sys; sys.exit(1)'])]
put(dict(id='SP-aaaaaaaa', kind='sprint', title='planted sprint', status='planned', goal='planted'))
def story(i, goal, touches):
    put(dict(id=i, kind='story', title='planted ' + i, status='draft', priority='P3', sprint='SP-aaaaaaaa', goal=goal, touches=touches, checks=bad))
story('ST-bbbbbbbb', 'The dispatcher imports bl_cost, a new import between _tools modules', ['_tools/bl_dispatch.py'])
story('ST-cccccccc', 'The dispatcher imports bl_cost, a new import between _tools modules', ['_tools/bl_dispatch.py', 'kb/_self/code.md'])
story('ST-dddddddd', 'The dispatcher prints one more line of text', ['_tools/bl_dispatch.py'])
buf = io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf):
    bl_check.cmd_check(bl_base.Backlog(d), types.SimpleNamespace())
lines = [l for l in buf.getvalue().splitlines() if 'code.md' in l]
print(lines)
sys.exit(0 if any('ST-bbbbbbbb' in l for l in lines) and not any(x in l for l in lines for x in ('ST-cccccccc', 'ST-dddddddd')) else 1)

notes: Recurred in SP-g2ssvhi2: TK-zqeq54ma added in-function imports of bl_cost, ql_capture and ql_distill to bl_dispatch.py, selfdoc stale named kb/_self/code.md (line 57) outside its touches, and the worker stopped; the orchestrator widened the touches on the branch and resumed it. TK-iyfruywl and ST-5z4e6z4i got code.md added before their claims for the same reason.
